The row code then defaulted missing stock to 0 (`item.stock ?? 0`), which showed "Out of stock" for every product.

I changed the screen to fetch both with `Promise.all` and merge stock into the products in one step. I also removed the `?? 0` fallback.

After relaunching the app, the Products list matches the API's `/stock` data. Lantern and Notebook (stock 0) show "Out of stock", and the other six show "In stock".
